text:
[Council File 26-1595; CD 9]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (PRICE - HUTT) relative to waiving and/or reimbursing associated administrative and lien fees in the amount of $3,629.61 for the property located at 1001 East 27th Street.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
INSTRUCT and AUTHORIZE the Department of Building and Safety to waive and/or reimburse associated administrative and lien fees in the amount of $3,629.61 for the property located at 1001 East 27th Street, subject to verification of full compliance with all outstanding corrective orders.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Planning and Land Use Management Committee waived consideration of the above matter)
